I be farmer for North West, here for Nigeria. My maize plot na small, 0.23 hectare, and I dey intercrop am with cowpea like usual, so the soil go get small help from the legume. I go try put small NPK 15-15-15 and urea if the subsidy reach me, but money tight so I no fit buy plenty. I get small manure from my goats and chickens wey I go carry come, and I go use my own saved seed because improved seed too cost for agro-dealer. No water for irrigation here, na rainfed farming, so I dey wait for the June rains. My wife and pikin dem go help me weed, but if grass too much I fit hire one or two young men for one or two days.
